notes.title: Restless Soul Launches TODAY!
notes.notes:
Hello Wandering Souls,

The Grim Reaper is calling…and the adventure of an afterlifetime awaits! We are excited to announce that Restless Soul launches TODAY! In case you’re still in limbo on this one, we’re sweetening the deal with a 20% launch discount, so nab this hauntingly humorous adventure game while this limited-time discount is alive and kicking.

Did we mention there’s a snarky ghost dog? Because, yes, that’s a thing. Check out the launch trailer below for a peek at this retro-fueled greyscale comedic romp complete with bullet-hell lite action, side challenges, and arcade-style minigames.

[previewyoutube=iXCV1r5AW4A;full][/previewyoutube]

Once you’ve joined the ranks of the undead, if you like what you see, please go ahead and leave a review to help support this ghoulish indie game crafted with love by a one-man team. Your support means the world, so please share your thoughts and help spread the word!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41419738/98163e7adfb72e41762bb8830199faeb8b29bfb7.gif[/img]

To stay in touch and up-to-date on all things Restless Soul, follow Fuz Games on [url=https://twitter.com/fuz_games]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.com/invite/nUZF23VP3r]Discord[/url], and for more great games, be sure to follow Graffiti Games on [url=https://twitter.com/Graffiti_Games]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.io/graffitigames]Discord[/url] as well.

notes.title: RESTLESS SOUL Launches September 1st!
notes.notes:
Greetings Soon-To-Be Wayward Souls,

The Afterlife is unusually alive with excitement today because we can finally announce Restless Soul’s launch date! Prospective souls can purchase and play the game on September 1, 2022.

In Restless Soul, you’ll play as a wayward soul trapped in the Afterlife who wishes to return to the land of the living. As a newly-admitted lost soul, you’ll forage the underbelly of the Afterlife looking for a way out. And for those who stand in you way? Watch out. 

In celebration of this announcement, you can check out our Gameplay Trailer to get a
little peek at what’s in store:

[previewyoutube=TirPyFmh0-g;full][/previewyoutube]
 
If you want to get on Death's good side, Wishlist the game now—you know you want to!

Until next time, we’ll see you around the Afterlife, and hopefully we’ll be hearing from you soon on [url=https://discord.com/invite/nUZF23VP3r]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/fuz_games]Twitter[/url].

Cheers,
Fuz Games

notes.title: RESTLESS SOUL Box Office Title Contest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41419738/ff2fddf4f8eb8e65874201f6113c0bffe2a80a5c.gif[/img]

Greetings from the AFTERLIFE! 

Ever wonder what movies would be box office hits in the AFTERLIFE? Now is your chance to find out! 

Come up with a clever movie title that would top the AFTERLIFE box office for a chance to have your movie title appear in-game and win a FREE movie (or two) on us via an [b]Amazon Gift Card![/b]

There will be one grand prize winner who will receive an Amazon gift card for $50 USD. The grand prize winner and bonus winners will also receive a copy of the game once it’s released and have their titles showcased in-game as well.

So how do you enter??? Use the hashtag #RSBoxOfficeContest on Twitter or join the game’s [url=https://discord.gg/nUZF23VP3r]Discord server[/url] and post in the submissions channel to enter! Movie titles must be appropriate for a game rated E for Everyone.

[b]The contest ends on January 25 at 10 A.M. PDT[/b], so you have until then to create your best AFTERLIFE box office movie titles!

And if you haven’t already, follow [i]RESTLESS SOUL[/i] on [url=https://twitter.com/fuz_games]Twitter[/url] to keep tabs on development.

notes.title: AFTERLIFE: Dying to Get Back! Is Now Restless Soul
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thank you for the amazing reaction to us announcing [i]AFTERLIFE: Dying to Get Back![/i] the other day! Unfortunately, we didn’t realize there were sooooooo many games with the name Afterlife, which has made it difficult for people to find our game. 

To make life easier for everyone (you’re still in the land of the living right?), we’re renaming [i]AFTERLIFE: Dying to Get Back![/i] to [i]RESTLESS SOUL![/i]

Here’s a new video of our protagonist telling the townspeople about the change. 

[previewyoutube=KAf91lEa8m0;full][/previewyoutube]

Join the official [i]Restless Soul[/i] [url=https://discord.gg/pRP8bcM6Uj]Discord[/url] and follow [i]Restless Soul[/i] on [url=https://twitter.com/fuz_games]Twitter[/url] to keep tabs on development. 

Cheers,
Fuz Games and Graffiti Games

notes.title: Comedic Adventure Game AFTERLIFE: Dying to Get Back! Coming Next Year
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We’re excited to announce our 2.5D comedic adventure game [i]AFTERLIFE: Dying to Get Back![/i], which will launch next year! In this hauntingly humorous title, you take control of the latest soul to arrive in the great beyond, but this spirit has some unfinished business back in the land of the living.  

You must find a way to return back to Life by exploring the mysterious AFTERLIFE and using your reflexes to evade bullet-hell battles. Have humorous discussions, take photos, and enjoy the journey. Be careful, there are others looking for a way to return from death.

Did we mention the humor?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41419738/a99371ba652955f874833df4b3c1336226bb8e78.gif[/img]

[b]Major Features Include:[/b]
[list]
[*] A soulful, single-player adventure full of pretentious and sometimes humorous quotes about life and death.
[*] Explore the mysterious AFTERLIFE and unlock hidden secrets as you find your way back to the land of the living.
[*] Meet a large cast of “colorful” 2D souls in a 3D world.
[*] Bullet-hell combat with ARPG elements. Use your skills to dodge and shoot at the right time.
[*] Battle dozens of henchman and leaders of an evil army with deadly motives.
[*] Solve clever puzzles that might have you scratching your head, but will leave you feeling super smart.
[*] Use your phone to keep track of your game’s progress, or take a bomb selfie.
[*] Rescue hidden souls, trapped in secret rooms.
[*] Special cameo appearance by the one-and-only, Grim Reaper.
[*] Pet a dog!
[/list]

Join the official [i]AFTERLIFE[/i] [url=https://discord.gg/pRP8bcM6Uj]Discord[/url] and follow [i]AFTERLIFE[/i] on [url=https://twitter.com/fuz_games]Twitter[/url] to keep tabs on development. 

[previewyoutube=85PMGB59Ctg;full]https://youtu.be/85PMGB59Ctg[/previewyoutube]

Cheers,
Fuz Games and Graffiti Games
